description: This file defines the CalculatorDisplay class, which implements the ICalcDisplay interface. It provides methods for updating the calculator's display, handling errors, expression display, memory, and history callbacks within the CalculatorApp's ViewModel layer.

classes.name: CalculatorDisplay
classes.description: Implements the ICalcDisplay interface to manage calculator display updates and callbacks within the ViewModel layer.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback reference for primary display updates.

methods.name: SetHistoryCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback reference for history updates.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Updates the primary display with a string and error state.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state of the display.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbers
methods.description: Updates the display with memorized numbers.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when a new history item is added.

methods.name: SetParenthesisNumber
methods.description: Sets the count of open parentheses.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when no right parenthesis is added.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles the event when maximum digit limit is reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Handles the event when a binary operator is received.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a memory item changes.
